INSERT INTO media_items (media_type, tmdb_id, title, poster_path)
                VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
                    ON CONFLICT (media_type, tmdb_id) DO UPDATE SET
                        title = EXCLUDED.title,
                        poster_path = EXCLUDED.poster_path,
                        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                RETURNING id
